source_of_truth: ERA34 plan and post-ERA33 runtime closure evidence
purpose: Define non-runtime control rules that prevent PROJECT_RUNTIME.json from remaining stale after a work unit is closed.
scope: Control-plane contract only. No feature work, no CORE upgrade, no root artifact creation.

staleness_definition.runtime_git_head_stale: PROJECT_RUNTIME.json git.head or current_head differs from git HEAD after closure.
staleness_definition.runtime_status_stale: current_work_unit or current_state.active_work_unit does not reflect the last closed work unit.
staleness_definition.next_safe_step_stale: next_safe_step points to an already-resolved blocker after closure.
staleness_definition.last_action_stale: last_action does not reference the final report or final gate of the closed work unit.

allowed_resolution.reason: Server workspace is source of truth for runtime state and git cleanliness.
allowed_resolution.commit_policy: Runtime closure patch must be committed and pushed after validation.
